propositions: Establish an immutable, serializable OperationSnapshot containing validated non-secret effective configuration values with explicit source-kind provenance, selected repository root, and envelope version.
Implement central composition with precedence: explicit operation input > environment > project config > user config > schema default, without creating a sixth configuration layer.

Thread snapshot through CLI, public library operations, MCP, and direct reconciler in shadow mode such that existing execution remains authoritative and snapshot assembly/diagnostic failures emit redacted warnings without altering behavior.

Ensure malformed selected operation config raises typed config error before lock/network/write effects, and secret wrappers/live capability objects are excluded from snapshot fields, serialization, and fingerprints.

Enable shadow mode by default via REBAR_OPERATION_SNAPSHOT_SHADOW with canonical false spelling to disable; remove this temporary switch in S7 without persisting snapshot or altering ticket/bridge formats.
